name: Mount Qingcheng and the Dujiangyan Irrigation System
description: Near Chengdu in Sichuan, this site pairs a forested Taoist mountain with an engineering feat more than 2,200 years old. The Dujiangyan system, begun in the 3rd century B.C., still tames the Minjiang River and channels its water to the farmland of the Chengdu plains. Nearby, Mount Qingcheng's 36 peaks hold ancient temples marking one of Taoism's birthplaces.
